verdict.rationale: Moss documents first-party integration pages for LangChain, which it says works in RAG pipelines and agentic workflows, and for the Vercel AI SDK, which exposes Moss operations as agent tools. It also lists LiveKit and Pipecat connectors. The evidence covers the core of the story, but its breadth and maintenance are unproven. Missing for 10: any LlamaIndex or other major RAG-framework integration, evidence that the integrations are actively maintained or versioned, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can plug the database into RAG and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.) through maintained first-class integrations

citations.quote: Connect Moss to LiveKit, Pipecat, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, and more.
This setup lets you use Moss in standard LangChain RAG pipelines and agentic workflows with sub-10ms retrieval latency.
This setup exposes Moss operations as AI SDK tools, so language models can search, create indexes, and manage documents as part of agentic workflows.
